title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 01
description:
At Jeminise, we understand the passion for baseball, and this personalized comforter set is designed for every baseball player, fan, and lover. It's not just bedding; it's a statement of determination and love for the game, crafted to bring comfort and style to any bedroom.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Perfect for baseball enthusiasts, offering a personalized touch for men, women, moms, and dads on special occasions like Valentine's, Mother's, Father's Day, and Christmas.
  • Personalized Design: Features two text input fields for custom personalization, allowing you to create a unique bedding set.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed dimensions.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric, known for its softness, comfort, durability, and lightweight feel, ensuring a cozy night's sleep.
  • Durable Construction: Features whole-piece microfiber filling with tight stitching to prevent clumping or shifting, ensuring longevity. The finishing process uses environmental protection techniques to prevent fading and maintain vibrant colors.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and dries quickly. It is recommended to air dry without heat or use a mesh laundry bag for best results.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, perfect for a complete bedding refresh.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Design Baseball and Flag Series 1
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Special Feature Breathable
Thread Count 400
Closure Type Zipper
Included Components Duvet Cover
Pillowcase Quantity 2
